Get financing in five simple steps

  1. 1

    Apply Online

    Choose a financing product and complete the application when it becomes available.

  2. 2

    Review and Verification

    The company reviews your application and verifies the information you provide.

  3. 3

    Get a Loan Offer

    If approved, you receive an offer with the amount, costs and repayment schedule.

  4. 4

    Review and Accept

    Review the Disclosure Statement and Terms and Conditions before accepting.

  5. 5

    Receive Funds

    After acceptance, funds are sent through the disbursement method shown in the offer.

Frequently Asked Questions

About our brands, loan terms and where to get help.

What is FlashBit Financing Corp.?

FlashBit Financing Corp. operates under the names of Livaya Financing, Alago Financing and Sulivo Financing.

Where can I find registration details?

See Company and regulatory information below for the SEC registration and Certificate of Authority details.

When will loan products be available?

The planned launch date is December 1, 2026, subject to confirmation.

Who can apply for a loan?

The proposed general requirements include being a Filipino citizen, at least 21 years old, with a valid government-issued ID and a regular source of income. Requirements may vary by product.

What documents should I prepare?

You may be asked for a government-issued ID, proof of income and proof of address. Check the requirements for your chosen product before applying.

How long does the review take?

Review timing depends on verification and the information needed for your application.

How will I receive the loan proceeds?

Check your loan offer for the available disbursement method and account requirements.

Where can I see the total cost?

Review the interest, fees, charges and total repayment in the Disclosure Statement before accepting a loan offer.

Who can I contact about personal data?

Read the Privacy Notice or contact the Data Protection Officer at dpoflashbit@gmail.com.
